title: IVG Savr 3000 Strawberry Kiwi Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Kiwi IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods deliver a vibrant blend of ripe Strawberry and tangy Kiwi for a well-rounded fruit vape. The sweetness of Strawberry pairs naturally with the tart Kiwi, creating a clean and refreshing flavour profile. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 4ml refill container that clicks into place for hands-free top-ups as you vape. Together they deliver up to 3000 puffs per kit, with no messy refills or coil replacements. The mesh coil ensures smooth vapour and full flavour, and the closed system makes setup simple and secure. Designed exclusively for the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
